_doc.tiers: Each provider has three tier slots: flagship (highest quality), standard (default), fast (cheapest/quickest). These map 1:1 to Claude Code's internal slots — flagship→opus, standard→sonnet, fast→haiku — used by `/model opus|sonnet|haiku` inside a session. The catalog uses semantic names; core.ps1/core.sh translates to Claude Code's env var contract.
_doc.contextByTier: Per-tier max context (tokens) when tiers differ. Picker shows min-max range. Omit when uniform.
_doc.qualityTier: Sort/tag label: flagship | standard | budget | free | slow.
_doc.envVars: Extra ANTHROPIC_* or CLAUDE_CODE_* env vars to set during launch. Applied AFTER the auto-context block so a provider can override the auto-derived values.
_doc._auto_context: core.ps1/core.sh auto-sets CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS + DISABLE_COMPACT=1 whenever the flagship tier context is >=500K. Threshold cleanly separates million-token class providers from sub-500K providers where losing auto-compact would be a bad trade. Source: contextByTier.flagship if present, else context. Tradeoff: when flagship/standard are large but fast is small (e.g. mimo flagship 1M / fast 256K), the env var stays at the flagship size for the whole session — /model haiku will display the larger value but the API will reject prompts beyond the fast model's real ceiling. Acceptable for opus-primary workflows. To opt a sub-500K provider in, set envVars explicitly in its block.
_doc._note_nvidia: NVIDIA NIM model IDs change frequently — verify at https://build.nvidia.com/explore/discover before relying on a tier mapping.
_doc._tier_mapping: flagship → /model opus, standard → /model sonnet, fast → /model haiku

atlas.displayName: Atlas Cloud Coding Plan (any model, GLM-5.3 default)
atlas.notes: Atlas Cloud Coding Plan — Anthropic-native endpoint at api.atlascloud.ai that serves ANY Atlas model (like cc-openrouter / cc-nvidia). 'cc-atlas <model>' overrides all three tiers with any Atlas model id in org/model form (e.g. zai-org/glm-5.3, deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4, minimax/minimax-m3); bare 'cc-atlas' uses the GLM-5.3 default in tiers below. Auth uses ATLAS_CP_API_KEY (the Coding Plan key, DISTINCT from the regular ATLAS_API_KEY used for Atlas's OpenAI-compatible /v1 API). Default GLM-5.3 is configured at 1M context so core.ps1/core.sh auto-derive CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS=1048576 + DISABLE_COMPACT=1 (see _doc._auto_context). Caveat: when you override to a smaller-window model, the env var stays at 1M (over-promises) — use /compact manually near the real limit. Atlas docs recommend CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS=1 (set via envVars). Discover model ids at https://www.atlascloud.ai/models.

deepseek.notes: Direct API via Anthropic-native /anthropic endpoint. deepseek-flash is the canonical identifier for current DeepSeek V4.1 Flash; DeepSeek has retired the old deepseek-v4-flash identifier, while deepseek-v4-pro is temporarily routed to V4.1 Flash. All tiers deliberately map to the current 1M-context model. core.ps1/core.sh auto-derive CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS=1000000 + DISABLE_COMPACT=1 (use /compact manually near the limit).

gemini.notes: Google Gemini 3.1 Pro (preview) via OpenRouter, 1M context, strong software-engineering coder. Single SKU on all three slots. 1M crosses the 500K threshold so core.ps1/core.sh auto-derive CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS=1000000 + DISABLE_COMPACT=1.

glm.notes: GLM-5.3 via OpenRouter. The current flagship and Flash model both advertise 1,310,720-token context windows. The full model occupies flagship/standard; GLM-5.3 Flash occupies fast. The flagship crosses the 500K threshold, so core.ps1/core.sh auto-derive CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS=1310720 + DISABLE_COMPACT=1 (use /compact manually near the limit). Use cc-glm instead of cc-zai-glm51 when US/EU latency matters.

grok.notes: xAI Grok 4.20 via OpenRouter — 2M context (largest in the catalog), reasoning model. Single SKU on all three slots. core.ps1/core.sh auto-derive CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS=2000000 + DISABLE_COMPACT=1 from the 2M context.

hy4.notes: Tencent's Hy4 preview is a 770B-total / 49B-active MoE productivity and agentic model. OpenRouter currently lists a 1,048,576-token context window and text-only modality. Tencent documents Anthropic Messages compatibility; an OpenRouter Anthropic request emitted the forced tool-use block on 2026-09-16, although its response used end_turn rather than tool_use as the stop reason. One preview SKU is mapped to all Claude Code tiers. This is a paid OpenRouter route; verify current pricing with cc-pricing before a long run.

kimi.notes: Kimi K3 is Moonshot's current 2.8T-parameter multimodal reasoning model for coding and long-horizon agentic work. It has a 1,048,576-token context window and supports tool calling. Single-tier mapping keeps /model opus|sonnet|haiku on the same current model; core.ps1/core.sh auto-derive CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS=1048576 + DISABLE_COMPACT=1.

minimax.notes: Direct API. MiniMax M3 is 1M context (released 2026-05-31). IMPORTANT: the /anthropic endpoint self-reports only ~200K in its model metadata (a known upstream bug inheriting Claude Sonnet's value), which makes Claude Code auto-compact early (~167K) unless overridden — so context is set to 1000000 here on purpose to drive CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS=1000000 + DISABLE_COMPACT=1 (see _doc._auto_context). No verified M3-highspeed fast SKU, so all three tiers map to MiniMax-M3.

minimax-or.notes: MiniMax M3 via OpenRouter — 1M context, US/EU-latency alternative to cc-minimax (direct api.minimax.io). Unlike the direct endpoint, OpenRouter reports the real 1M window, so no self-report workaround needed. Single SKU on all three slots.

mimo.notes: MiMo V2.5 Pro and MiMo V2.5 are the current OpenRouter models, each with a 1,048,576-token context window. The retired V2-Flash ID was removed from the fast slot; standard now supplies the fast slot as the supported fallback. core.ps1/core.sh auto-derive CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS=1048576 + DISABLE_COMPACT=1.

muse.notes: Muse Spark 1.2 has no provider-published context window available to verify, so context is explicitly 0 and cc-switcher does not disable Claude Code auto-compaction. Update this field only from provider documentation or a live model listing.

nemotron.notes: FREE via OpenRouter. Nemotron 3 Ultra is the current 550B/55B-active open-weight free route and advertises a 1M-token context window. cc-nvidia (direct API) is separate — this is the OpenRouter-hosted free tier.

nvidia.notes: Free tier with rate limits. Defaults were verified against the authenticated NVIDIA model listing: Kimi K3 (flagship), Nemotron 3 Ultra (standard), and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning (fast). Context remains conservatively pinned to 128K because direct NIM tier windows vary. cc-nvidia <model-id> overrides all three tiers.

ollama-glm.notes: GLM-5.3 on Ollama Cloud (hosted inference). Ollama speaks the Anthropic Messages API at https://ollama.com; auth via OLLAMA_API_KEY (key from ollama.com/settings/keys, sent as ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN). The model tag is exactly glm-5.3:cloud — the :cloud suffix is mandatory (it routes to hosted inference instead of a local pull). Ollama lists a 1M-token window, so core.ps1/core.sh auto-derive CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS=1000000 + DISABLE_COMPACT=1. Smoke-test once: Ollama's docs mostly show the localhost:11434 path, the direct cloud Anthropic base is community/issue-attested.

ollama-minimax.notes: MiniMax M3 on Ollama Cloud (hosted inference). Anthropic Messages API at https://ollama.com; auth via OLLAMA_API_KEY (sent as ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN). The model tag is exactly minimax-m3:cloud — the :cloud suffix is mandatory. Ollama serves this tag at a 512K window (the model's guaranteed minimum), so context is set to 512K here, NOT the full 1M — for the guaranteed 1M MiniMax M3 use cc-minimax (direct) or cc-minimax-or (OpenRouter). Smoke-test the cloud Anthropic base once before relying on it.

qwen.notes: Qwen3.8 Max 0902 is Alibaba's current flagship for coding and agentic work. Qwen3.8 27B is the standard tier and Qwen3.8 Flash is the fast tier; all three expose a 1M-token context window and tool calling through OpenRouter. core.ps1/core.sh auto-derive CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS=1000000 + DISABLE_COMPACT=1.

xiaomi.notes: Direct Xiaomi MiMo token-plan endpoint (Singapore region). Anthropic-native, distinct from cc-mimo (OpenRouter). Tier IDs verified 2026-05-09 against /v1/models listing — gateway exposes only mimo-v2.5-pro, mimo-v2.5, and mimo-v2-pro for chat (plus omni/TTS variants not used here). No 'flash' SKU exists on this gateway, so the fast slot maps to the older-gen mimo-v2-pro. Auth uses x-api-key header in Anthropic format. Flagship (mimo-v2.5-pro) is 1M context — confirmed by Ryan 2026-05-09. Standard/fast contexts on this direct gateway are not yet verified, so kept conservative at the 256K floor. core.ps1/core.sh auto-derives CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS=1048576 from contextByTier.flagship.

codex.disabledReason: ChatGPT OAuth tokens cannot authenticate the public OpenAI API, which also lacks an Anthropic Messages endpoint. Use native 'codex login --device-auth', or 'cc-openrouter openai/gpt-5.4' with OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
codex.notes: Retained as a migration guard. Direct ChatGPT OAuth cannot power Claude Code; cc-codex and cc-codex-login fail with supported alternatives.

opencode-minimax.displayName: MiniMax M3 via OpenCode Go (US endpoint)
opencode-minimax.notes: US-hosted MiniMax M3 via OpenCode Go subscription. Anthropic-format compatible (MiniMax/Qwen route to the Anthropic surface on Go; GLM/Kimi do NOT — they're OpenAI-only there). M3 is natively 1M but OpenCode Go's effective cap is unverified, so context kept conservative at ~200K. For guaranteed 1M MiniMax M3 use cc-minimax (direct) or cc-minimax-or (OpenRouter).

owl-alpha.notes: LongCat 2.0 is Meituan's public successor to the retired OpenRouter Owl Alpha stealth release. It is a paid text-only OpenRouter route. OpenRouter's live registry reports the exact 1,048,756-token context field; listed prices can change. A forced Anthropic Messages tool call succeeded on 2026-09-16. The cc-owl name stays as a compatibility command.

zai-glm51.notes: China-based endpoint. Direct model discovery confirms glm-5.3 and glm-5.3-flash; the older [1m] suffix is not used for these current IDs. The 1M context setting remains conservative for the direct route. Command is still cc-zai-glm51 for backward compatibility. Use cc-glm (OpenRouter) instead for the same model with US/EU latency.
